brief_rationale: All responsibility chain items are met with no serious or minor errors. Doctor correctly escalates patient to ED after discovering melena, provides prioritized cost-conscious testing plan, and maintains appropriate boundaries. HO1 is complete for friction navigation (prioritized minimum tests, cost-sensitive advice, patient executed plan). HO2 is complete for responsibility chain repair (identified broken follow-up chain, assigned receiving clinicians as owners). HO3 partial - closure is safe and bounded but terminal status prevents explicit patient confirmation. Grade 4 per deterministic rubric: no RC errors + one completed HO.
